description: This Java class defines a model for representing the synchronization result status in the Nextcloud Notes Android client, including success flags for pull and push operations and a static constant for failure state.

classes.name: SyncResultStatus
classes.description: A class representing the status of synchronization operations, with flags for pull and push success, and a static instance indicating failure.
